summary: Make TinyDB JSONStorage writes crash-safe so a process dying mid-write can't leave a truncated db.json. Only the initial code exploration is recorded so far.
narrative: The owner asked for crash-safe JSONStorage writes after a service was OOM-killed mid-write and left a truncated db.json that TinyDB could no longer open. The only recorded work is an exploration of tinydb/storages.py (observation #1). It found that JSONStorage keeps a long-lived r+ file handle and has no atomic write path. No implementation, PR or release appears in memory yet.

milestones.text: Owner reports a truncated db.json after an OOM kill and asks for crash-safe JSONStorage writes.
Exploration finds JSONStorage uses a long-lived r+ handle with no atomic write path.
